title: Implement FT-005 photo catalog, artifact storage, and manifest service
verify: Migration/model tests prove photo_catalog_items native UUID identity, restrictive FKs, optional check_in_id ownership, accepted photo_type/content_type, size limit, local_only=true, can_train_on=false, and event_refs.
Filesystem tests prove safe relative layout, ignored user filenames, temp-write plus atomic rename, immutable accepted originals/manifests, and no absolute path leakage.
Manifest tests prove photo_manifest.v1 fields match the catalog row and store photo_id as the same UUID as photo_artifact_id.
Checksum tests prove catalog and manifest sha256 match the stored original.

Service tests prove authorized active Boss/Engineer acceptance, Consultant/unauthorized/revoked/disabled/archived denial, safe cleanup on failed file/manifest/catalog/checksum/timeline steps, and no accepted-photo success without photo_accepted event refs.
Behavior specs FT-005-BHV-001 through FT-005-BHV-003 have direct executable traceability in focused tests.
evidence_required: service authorization and cleanup test output
constraints: Use LOCAL_ARTIFACT_ROOT and PostgreSQL/read-model authority; do not introduce object storage, remote sync, or filesystem scanning as catalog authority.
Use one accepted-photo UUID: photo_id is the storage/API name for photo_artifact_id.
Accepted photo success requires stored original, manifest, catalog row, sha256, local_only=true, can_train_on=false, and photo_accepted timeline ref.
Cleanup may remove only files created for the failed generated upload path and must not delete unrelated local data or retained history.
Do not implement Vision processing, thumbnails, annotations, export packages, dataset trainability transitions, Plant history UI, or PWA components.
invariants: Photo artifacts are evidence refs and cannot override PostgreSQL Plant state.
Timeline events and manifests are audit/export/supporting artifacts, not mutable runtime authority.
New accepted photos are local_only=true and can_train_on=false.
Secrets, auth material, user filenames, absolute paths, provider payloads, and hidden reasoning never enter catalog rows, manifests, timeline events, logs, or evidence.
verification_targets: Inject file, manifest, catalog, checksum, and timeline failures and prove no accepted-photo success is returned.
Trace FT-005-BHV-001 through FT-005-BHV-003 to concrete passing tests.
purpose: Create the local photo artifact authority boundary for accepted photo files, catalog metadata, manifests, checksums, and audit refs before HTTP exposure.
success_outcome: FT-005 can accept a Plant photo only through authorized service logic that writes one local artifact set, one catalog identity, one manifest, sha256, trainability defaults, and a photo_accepted timeline ref.
anti_goals: No multipart HTTP routes in this task.
No Vision processing, thumbnails, annotations, export packages, or remote sync.
No dataset trainability transition beyond default false.
No Plant history UI, timeline pagination, or PWA implementation.

forbidden_scope: Vision processing, thumbnails, annotations, export package generation, or remote sync
dataset trainability approval or registry implementation
Plant history UI, timeline pagination, or PWA behavior
stop_conditions: TASK-020-T3-FT-004-W2 is not done or optional check_in_id association cannot be validated against FT-004 check-ins.
The implementation would need a second photo identity instead of the specified photo_id/photo_artifact_id UUID.
Safe cleanup cannot distinguish task-created files from unrelated local data.
Diagnostics or evidence contain secrets, auth material, absolute local paths, user-controlled destination paths, provider payloads, or hidden reasoning.
